blockers.title: Historical revision authority is omitted at response and model-turn boundaries
blockers.reproduction: selected={code:after}; allowed_delta_pairs contains before/after. authorize permits both, then revoke before during read. resolve(read of before) returns resolved content AAA= despite authority false. delta also returns before metadata after revocation. check(tool_response) and check(model_turn) enumerate only selected after.
blockers.impact: Current authority of old revision is not rechecked before returning or delivering its content; revocation after a previous successful historical read is also missed before later turns reuse its history.
blockers.fix: Track all actual source revisions in each response and retained model history, including both delta endpoints, historical range bodies, namespace/absence evidence. Reauthorize relevant union at response publication, each model turn and proposal application. A conservative selected plus all explicitly allowed delta endpoints check is acceptable if intentional; factory must query current actor/producer, original requirement document and module rights, not grant-only state.

blockers.title: Page/range limits bound output but not underlying whole-body reads
blockers.reproduction: Actual NativeStore: 120 objects x 65536 bytes. Page 1 returns 63 entries/16384 JSON bytes but reads all 120 bodies (7864320 bytes). Page 2 returns 57 entries/14707 bytes and rereads all 120 (another 7864320 bytes). A 2-byte range reads all 65536 bytes.
blockers.impact: Metadata pagination causes O(pages * selected body bytes) full blob verification and I/O. Range reads cause O(object bytes) allocation/hash per tiny chunk. NativeStore itself has no object-size/count limit; ordinary Worker does have 2MiB/object and 8MiB total defaults, but old delta endpoints are not bounded by current materialization. Response budgets alone cannot establish bounded host I/O/memory or efficiency.
blockers.fix: Add trusted NativeStore bounded metadata length/pagination and exact byte-range API, and explicit source/operation budgets. Preserve whole-object SHA256 integrity: do not substitute unauthenticated SQL substr. Use bounded-memory streaming verification with identity-bound trusted validated cache/index and invalidation, or authenticated chunk design. Document cold full verification cost versus warm range cost. Manifest metadata must not read all bodies to calculate lengths; avoid rebuilding unlimited full revision metadata per page.
